🔴 ثبت کالای جدید در دیجی کالا و گرفتن تایید

🔹 ما فروشنده دیجی کالا هستیم و میخوایم تعداد 300 عدد کالای مختلف در دیجی کالا قرار بدیم به اسم برند خودمون
نیاز به شخصی داریم که مراحلی که میگیم انجام بده کار بسیار راحتیه
1. با AIدرخواست بده که کالا با اسم برند خودمون در ابعاد 2500 2500 پیکسل ساخته بشه
2.کالای ساخته شده در قسمت ثبت برند جدید دیجی کالا توی صفحه خودمون در قرار بده
3.تاییدیه ثبت کالا بگیره ( دیجی کالا یک روز نیاز به بررسی کالا داره و بعضی وقت ها اگه بارگذاری محصول ایراد املایی یا عکس یا مشخصات داشته باشه تایید نمیده و نیاز به اصلاح میزنه )

items.title: تحقیق کلمات کلیدی و سئوی فروشگاه پوشاک زنانه
items.description:
🔴 تحقیق کلمات کلیدی و سئوی فروشگاه پوشاک زنانه

🔹 شرح کلی پروژه:
سایت فروشگاهی موجودی با WordPress در زمینه پوشاک زنانه قرار است از نظر سئو بهبود پیدا کند. هدف پروژه، انتخاب کلمات کلیدی مناسب و اجرای اقدامات مرتبط با ارتقای جایگاه سایت در نتایج جست‌وجوی گوگل برای کلمات کلیدی مرتبط با پوشاک زنانه است.
محدوده کار و مسئولیت فریلنسر:
• بررسی و تحقیق کلمات کلیدی مرتبط با حوزه فعالیت سایت
• ارائه فهرست کلمات کلیدی مناسب برای تمرکز سئویی سایت
• اجرای اقدامات سئو و بهینه‌سازی‌هایی که به بهبود وضعیت سایت در گوگل کمک می‌کند
• بررسی وضعیت موجود سایت و تعیین اقدامات اجرایی موردنیاز در چارچوب سئو
وضعیت فعلی و مرز مسئولیت:
سایت از قبل راه‌اندازی شده و با WordPress ساخته شده است؛ بنابراین موضوع پروژه، بهبود و بهینه‌سازی سایت موجود است، نه ایجاد یک سایت جدید. تولید محتوای سایت بر عهده کارفرماست و در مسئولیت فریلنسر قرار ندارد. با این حال، فریلنسر مسئول اجرای سایر اقدامات مرتبط با ارتقای سئو است و هر بخش اجرایی موردنیاز باید در پیشنهاد و برآورد او به‌طور شفاف توضیح داده شود.
خروجی مورد انتظار:
خروجی اصلی شامل فهرست کلمات کلیدی مناسب و اجرای اقدامات سئو برای بهبود رتبه سایت فروشگاهی در نتایج جست‌وجوی گوگل است. جزئیات اقدامات اجرایی، پیش‌نیازهای آن‌ها و مواردی که برای انجام به همکاری یا ورودی کارفرما نیاز دارند، در پروپوزال مشخص شود.
موارد پیشنهادی برای بررسی در پروپوزال:
• روش پیشنهادی برای تحقیق و اولویت‌بندی کلمات کلیدی
• دامنه دقیق اقدامات سئو و مواردی که برای اجرا نیاز به دسترسی یا همکاری کارفرما دارند
• برآورد هزینه و زمان انجام کار
• نمونه تجربه‌های مرتبط با سئوی سایت‌های فروشگاهی و حوزه پوشاک

❕ ترکیبی از قیمت و کیفیت اهمیت دارد.

items.title: بازطراحی حرفه‌ای UI/UX صرافی ارز دیجیتال، رفع باگ‌ها و طراحی
items.description:
🔴 بازطراحی حرفه‌ای UI/UX صرافی ارز دیجیتال، رفع باگ‌ها و طراحی

🔹 برای وب‌سایت صرافی ارز دیجیتال خود به یک توسعه‌دهنده یا تیم باتجربه نیاز دارم تا قالب و رابط کاربری فعلی را به‌صورت اصولی بررسی و بازطراحی کند. وب‌سایت در حال حاضر راه‌اندازی شده و اسکریپت اصلی آن آماده است؛ بنابراین هدف، ساخت یک پروژه از صفر نیست، بلکه بهبود جدی ظاهر، تجربه کاربری، کیفیت فنی و قابلیت توسعه پلتفرم موجود است.
. بازطراحی قالب و رابط کاربری صرافی
ظاهر فعلی نیاز به بازنگری دارد و می‌خواهم رابط صرافی حرفه‌ای‌تر، منسجم‌تر و باکیفیت‌تر شود. انتظار دارم پیش از اعمال تغییرات، صفحات و ساختار فعلی بررسی شوند و سپس طراحی جدید با درنظرگرفتن نیازهای کاربران یک پلتفرم معاملاتی ارائه شود.
موارد مورد انتظار:
طراحی ظاهری حرفه‌ای، مدرن و مناسب یک پلتفرم مالی
ایجاد هویت بصری منسجم برای رنگ‌ها، فونت‌ها، آیکون‌ها، دکمه‌ها و اجزای رابط
بازطراحی چیدمان صفحات و پنل‌های مختلف صرافی
بهبود خوانایی اطلاعات، سلسله‌مراتب بصری و کنتراست
بهبود تجربه کاربری در نسخه دسکتاپ و موبایل
واکنش‌گرا بودن صفحات در اندازه‌های مختلف نمایشگر
رفع شلوغی، فضاهای خالی نامناسب و ناهماهنگی‌های بصری
طراحی مناسب حالت‌های خالی، خطا، بارگذاری و پیام‌های موفقیت
حفظ عملکردهای فعلی سامانه، مگر در مواردی که برای اصلاح یا بهبود، تغییر آن‌ها با توافق لازم باشد
بازطراحی نباید صرفاً به تغییر رنگ‌ها یا چند جزئیات ظاهری محدود شود؛ انتظار دارم نتیجه نهایی از نظر چیدمان، انسجام و کیفیت اجرا تفاوت محسوسی با قالب فعلی داشته باشد.
۲. بررسی و رفع باگ‌های موجود
در حال حاضر چند ایراد و باگ جزئی در سایت وجود دارد که لازم است پس از بررسی، شناسایی و برطرف شوند. پیش از شروع، موارد قابل‌رفع و روش انجام کار مشخص شود و اصلاحات بدون ایجاد اختلال در قابلیت‌های اصلی سایت انجام گیرد.
۳. اصلاح مسیر و دسترسی صفحه مدیریت
آدرس صفحه ادمین باید بررسی و اصلاح شود تا مسیر مدیریت به‌درستی کار کند و دسترسی مدیران سایت بدون مشکل انجام شود. این کار باید با رعایت اصول امنیتی و بدون ایجاد اختلال در ورود کاربران یا سایر بخش‌های سامانه انجام شود.
۴. طراحی لندینگ‌پیج با وردپرس
نیاز دارم با استفاده از WordPress یک لندینگ‌پیج حرفه‌ای برای معرفی صرافی طراحی شود. صفحه باید با هویت بصری سامانه هماهنگ باشد و برای معرفی خدمات و هدایت کاربران به ثبت‌نام یا استفاده از پلتفرم طراحی شود.
انتظار می‌رود لندینگ‌پیج:
ظاهر حرفه‌ای و متناسب با برند داشته باشد؛
در موبایل و دسکتاپ به‌درستی نمایش داده شود؛
امکان ویرایش محتوای معمول را از طریق وردپرس فراهم کند؛
از نظر سرعت، ساختار و اصول پایه سئو مناسب باشد؛
به سایت یا بخش ثبت‌نام صرافی به‌درستی لینک شود.
۵. آمادگی برای توسعه‌های بعدی
ممکن است در مراحل بعدی، قابلیت‌ها و امکانات جدیدی به وب‌سایت اضافه شود. بنابراین همکاری با فردی مدنظر است که بتواند ساختار فعلی پروژه را بشناسد، تغییرات را با احتیاط و مستند انجام دهد و برای توسعه‌های آینده نیز قابل‌دسترس باشد. جزئیات قابلیت‌های احتمالی آینده در صورت توافق، جداگانه تعریف و برآورد خواهند شد.

Reolink , a leader in intelligent visual technology for homes and businesses, was founded in 2009 by a group of engineers with a strong commitment to and passion for smarter security solutions.

Our products are now trusted by millions of users across more than 110 countries and regions worldwide. Building on this trust, we continue expanding our presence and bringing our innovations to more markets around the globe. Reolink remains committed to delivering advanced, reliable, and user‑centric solutions that empower people to protect what matters most.

Position: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Engineer
5 Work Days Per Week
Office Near Tai Seng MRT, Singapore
Medical Benefits Provided
Entitled to Yearly Bonus & Performance Bonus

Job Summary

We are looking for a Technical SEO Specialist with strong expertise in modern SEO, technical optimization, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) / AI Search to strengthen our online visibility and organic growth.
The role will be responsible for improving website technical performance, search engine rankings, content discoverability, and visibility across AI-powered search platforms such as Google AI Overviews and other generative search engines.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical SEO knowledge with an understanding of how search algorithms and AI-driven search experiences are evolving.

Requirements

Is a plus if proficiency in English or other foreign languages (written preferable) is required to conduct localized keyword research, content optimization, and competitor analysis in the target markets in United States, Australia or Euro countries ( United Kingdom, Italy, Turkey, France, Germany, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Sweden, Portugal and so on)
Experience managing overseas SEO projects and optimizing websites for Western Markets is highly preferred.
Keywords for this post include Content Gap Analysis, Competitor Analysis, Organic Traffic, Ranking Positions, Domain Authority, Conversion Rate
Manage SEO-related assets, tools / platforms including Google My Business, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Google Keyword Planner, Ahrefs, Semrush, Majestic, Screaming Frog
Develop and execute technical SEO strategies to improve organic search performance.
Conduct technical SEO audits covering crawling, indexing, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data, and website performance.
Implement modern SEO practices including entity SEO, semantic search, topical authority, and structured content.
Develop GEO strategies to improve brand and content visibility in AI-generated search results.
Monitor Google Search, AI search platforms, rankings, traffic, and SEO performance using relevant analytics and SEO tools.
Collaborate with developers, content teams, and marketing teams to implement SEO improvements.
Stay updated on Google algorithm changes, AI search developments, and emerging SEO / GEO best practices.

items.description:
Company Description Cantrell Schuette is a Tampa-based law firm dedicated to correcting injustice. Our niches inclide protecting franchisee rights, employee rights, and personal injury. The firm offers a supportive environment for legal and non-legal professionals who want to contribute to meaningful, impact-driven work.

Role Description The Senior SEO Specialist is a full-time, hybrid role based in Tampa, FL. This role is responsible for developing and executing comprehensive SEO strategies to increase organic visibility, qualified traffic, and lead generation for the firm’s practice areas.

Day-to-day responsibilities include performing keyword research, optimizing on-page content and metadata, managing technical SEO initiatives, and improving site architecture and internal linking. The Senior SEO Specialist will monitor rankings and performance metrics, analyze data, and prepare reports with actionable insights for leadership and marketing teams. The role also involves collaborating on content planning, coordinating with external vendors when needed, and staying current with search engine algorithm updates and best practices in legal industry SEO. Preference for experience eith digital ads too, including Google, Facebook, Instagram, and AI.

Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong skills in keyword research, on-page optimization, and content optimization.
Candidates should possess skills in technical SEO, including site audits, crawl and index management, page speed optimization, and structured data implementation.
Candidates should possess skills in analytics and reporting, including use of tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and SEO platforms (e.g., SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz).
Candidates should possess skills in link-building strategy, competitive analysis, and organic traffic growth initiatives.
Candidates should possess skills in cross-functional collaboration, communicating SEO recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders, and aligning SEO with broader marketing goals.
Relevant experience in SEO within professional services, legal, or similar regulated industries is beneficial.
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and thrive in a hybrid work environment is expected.

وبسایت فروشگاه آنلاین کتاب در زمینه های قانون جذب، موفقیت، ثروت و ... هستش و از فروردین 1404 بالا اومده و به صورت اختصاصی با لاراول برنامه نویسی شده است.

اما نمیدونم چرا "کتاب های کوین ترودو" سرچ شدنی مقاله "17 کتاب پیشنهادی کوین ترودو" در رتبه دوم گوگل قرار میگیره.

اینکه همچنین مهم هستش که تمام تک به تک کتاب ها هم همراه با همین دسته بندی ها بالا بیان.
ابتدا باهم 3 ماه کار میکنیم، درصورت رضایت دوطرفه در یک پروژه جدید باهم ادامه خواهیم داد.

In this agency role, you won't just run traditional SEO campaigns-you will bridge technical SEO, high-intent keyword strategies, and cutting-edge Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.

You must be a natural problem-solver who uses AI tools and automation to streamline repetitive execution, free up strategic bandwidth, and deliver clear pipeline results for multi-client accounts.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Keyword & Entity Strategy (SEO + AEO)

High-Intent B2B Keyword Mapping: Uncover non-branded, high-intent BOFU (Bottom-of-Funnel) keywords, intent clusters, and buyer queries that drive pipeline rather than just vanity traffic.

AEO & LLM Optimization: Identify entity relationships, brand citations, and prompt queries used across AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot).

Search Intent & Gap Analysis: Run competitive content gap analyses to map buyer journeys across traditional search SERPs and AI response outputs.

On-Page & Content Optimization

AEO Content Engineering: Structure and optimize client content for direct retrieval by LLMs-focusing on concise answer blocks, clear headers, schema alignment, and authoritative citations.

On-Page Execution: Optimize meta tags, heading hierarchies, internal linking structures, CTA placements, and content freshups across client web properties.

AI-Assisted Content Briefs: Produce detailed, data-backed content briefs using AI workflows to scale quality output for client writing teams.

Technical SEO & Site Architecture

Comprehensive Audits: Perform deep-dive technical audits across complex B2B sites.

Technical Fixes: Resolve issues related to crawlability, indexability, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, page speed, canonicalization, and XML sitemaps.

Schema & Structured Data: Implement advanced schema markup (Organization, Product, Article, FAQ, TechArticle) to strengthen site entities for both search engines and LLM indexers.

Off-Page & Brand Authority

Digital PR & Citation Strategy: Build brand authority and digital footprint through high-quality B2B backlink profiles, unlinked mention reclamation, and strategic guest placements.

LLM Visibility Building: Drive inclusion in trusted third-party review sites (G2, Capterra, Gartner), tech publications, and industry directories that modern LLMs use as grounding data.

AI-Powered Automation & Workflow Scaling

Task Automation: Leverage custom GPTs, APIs, or automation platforms (Make, Zapier, Python scripts) to automate repetitive tasks like meta creation, internal link mapping, technical monitoring, and keyword clustering.

Workflow Optimization: Use AI tools to accelerate strategy creation and analysis without sacrificing quality or accuracy.

Analytics, Client Reporting & Growth Ownership

Multi-Client Portfolio Management: Simultaneously balance campaign strategy, technical execution, and project timelines across 4–6 B2B tech accounts.

Data & Attribution Modeling: Analyze performance using GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs/SEMrush, and BI tools (Looker Studio) to track traffic, conversions, MQLs, and SQLs.

Client Presentations & Communication: Translate complex technical data into clear business narratives. Lead monthly/quarterly strategy calls with CMOs, VP of Marketing, and demand gen leaders.

Problem Solving & Result Delivery: Proactively identify drop-offs or algorithm impact, pivot strategies rapidly, and take personal accountability for achieving quarterly KPIs (pipeline growth, keyword ownership, AI share of voice).

Requirements

Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: 3 to 8 years of hands-on SEO/AEO experience, with a heavy emphasis on B2B Tech or SaaS brands.

Agency Experience: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client accounts, prioritize tasks under deadlines, and pivot strategies based on client goals.
AEO & Generative Search Expertise: Solid understand of vector search, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), entity graphs, and how modern AI tools retrieve and synthesise content.
AI & Automation Proficiency: Practical, hands-on experience using AI software and automation scripts to handle heavy-lifting operational tasks.
Client-Facing Skills: Strong verbal and written communication. Comfortable presenting data, answering tough questions on calls, and advising client marketing leads.
Tool Stack Mastery: Advanced experience with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, and Looker Studio.

Utilizzerai quotidianamente strumenti come Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SeoZoom e Screaming Frog

Ti trovi a tuo agio nel lavorare in team e nel collaborare con figure diverse (content manager, web analyst, web developer).
Sei costantemente informato sulle principali tendenze di settore, in particolare sull’evoluzione delle piattaforme basate su AI (Chagpt, Gemini, Perplexity).
Italiano e Inglese fluenti.

چهار وب‌سایت انگلیسی در حوزه‌های مختلف دارم که می‌خواهم از نظر سئو به‌صورت دقیق و کامل بررسی شوند و گزارشی از فرصت‌های رشد و بهبود رتبه آن‌ها دریافت کنم، این پروژه فقط مربوط به بررسی، تولید گزارش و پیشنهاد استراتژی برای بهبود هست.
من دو هدف اصلی دارم:
1. با توجه به وضعیت فعلی هر سایت، رقبا و شرایط بازار، مشخص کنیم کدام برندها چقدر پتانسیل رشد دارند و با اجرای یک استراتژی سئوی مناسب، تا چه حد می‌توان رتبه و ترافیک آن‌ها را افزایش داد؟
از آنجا که با مدیران این برندها در ارتباط هستم، می‌خواهم روی سایت‌هایی تمرکز کنم که واقعاً ظرفیت پیشرفت قابل‌توجهی دارند. هدفم این است که با بهبود سئوی آن‌ها، تأثیر کار ما بر افزایش بازدید و در نهایت فروش، به‌وضوح قابل‌اندازه‌گیری باشد.
2. یک گزارش خیلی کامل از وضعیت این برندها از در سیستم‌های هوش مصنوعی می‌خوام، مثلا نظر چت جی پی تی، کلاد، Google Overviews و... لطفا از تجربیات AEO بگید.
دسترسی به آنالیتیکس یا سرچ کنسول نداریم و کل بررسی باید از بیرون انجام بشه.
این نکته رو اضافه کنم که خودم متخصص سئو هستم، پس لطفا از تحلیل‌های سطحی و وعده‌های رویایی دوری کنید، هرچه پیشنهادتون به واقعیت نزدیکتر باشه من شما رو کاندید جدی‌تری می‌بینم.
هزینه این پروژه به‌صورت کامل پرداخت می‌شه، اما ارزش اصلی همکاری در فرصت‌های بعدی هست. اگر نتایج خوبی بگیریم و یک نمونه‌کار موفق بسازیم، پروژه‌های بیشتری از برندهای مختلف با بودجه دلاری برای همکاری دارم.

items.title: SEO/GEO specialist (junior)

items.title: SEO Specialist
items.description:
En SIDN te queremos

¿Eres una persona apasionada del SEO que ha enfocado su desarrollo en el nuevo paradigma GEO y Search IA?

Buscamos a una persona apasionada del SEO y el aprendizaje contínuo,con visión analítica, autonomía y enfoque estratégico para gestionar proyectos de medio y alto nivel.

Tu objetivo será conectar los datos y necesidades del negocio con la visibilidad y presencia en motores de búsqueda generativos y LLM.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Ejecutar estrategias GEO avanzadas y gestionar de forma autónoma proyectos clave en SIDN.
Actuar como referente operativo dentro de un equipo internacional de alto rendimiento.
Colaborar de manera transversal con otras áreas y especialistas para potenciar búsquedas multimodales (Dev, Paid, UX, CRO, ORM, etc.).
Generar un impacto directo y medible en el crecimiento orgánico, tráfico cualificado, menciones y citas en LLMs y negocio de los clientes.

¿Qué esperamos de ti ?

Desarrollar un research avanzado que integre queries tradicionales, intención semántica y patrones de búsqueda en LLMs.
Trabajar las entidades y la autoridad de forma integral (consistencia de marca, contenidos, arquitectura web, PR digital).
Definir y ejecutar estrategias de contenido multimodal y EEAT accionable (texto, imágenes, vídeo, señales on-site y off-site).
Diseñar estrategias SEO locales e internacionales adaptadas a distintos mercados y contextos culturales.
Gestionar proyectos priorizando iniciativas según su impacto, esfuerzo y retorno mediante roadmaps claros.
Impulsar la sinergia entre los distintos equipos (Producto, Dev, Contenidos, Paid, etc.) para maximizar el impacto global.
Convertir los datos en decisiones de negocio mediante analítica web, herramientas GEO y dashboards, comunicando los resultados y oportunidades al cliente.

Competencias

SEO Técnico Avanzado: Conocimiento profundo de arquitectura web, datos estructurados y marcado semántico.
Estrategia de Contenidos: Experiencia en la creación de clústeres temáticos y contenidos de alta autoridad.
Stack Tecnológico: Valorable el manejo de herramientas SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush) combinadas con plataformas de IA y automatización (Python, SQL o herramientas RAG).
Pensamiento analítico y estratégico con una clara orientación a resultados de negocio.
Comunicación clara y eficaz (con clientes y equipos internos) para generar confianza y alineación.
Visión colaborativa para trabajar de forma integrada con perfiles multidisciplinares.
Capacidad de adaptación y aprendizaje continuo, especialmente ante la evolución de la IA generativa y nuevos formatos de búsqueda.
Proactividad, responsabilidad y mentalidad de ownership (adueñarte del proyecto).

Conocimientos y experiencia

Mínimo 2-3 años de experiencia demostrable en proyectos SEO (al menos 1 año en agencia).
Trabajo demostrable en GEO durante los dos últimos años o desde la irrupción de la IA en motores de búsqueda.
Experiencia en la definición y ejecución de estrategias SEO enfocadas a resultados comerciales.
Dominio de herramientas clave del sector: Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog, Semrush, Sistrix, Ahrefs, etc.
Analítica SEO y GEO avanzada y capacidad para extraer insights (dashboarding, reporting, data storytelling).
Se valora positivamente: Conocimientos básicos en APIs, SQL, Python y experiencia en entornos de automatización SEO.

Formación

Grado, Máster o FP relacionados con Marketing, Marketing Digital, Comunicación o titulaciones similares.
Formaciones complementarias y certificaciones específicas del ámbito SEO.
Se valora positivamente: Nivel de inglés conversacional.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

¡Un comienzo a lo grande!

Programa de onboarding diseñado para que te integres rápidamente en la compañía y te sientas parte del equipo desde el primer día, facilitandote las herramientas necesarias para tu adaptación a tu rol y a la cultura de SIDN.

Flexibilidad y equilibrio:

Modelo híbrido: Combina lo mejor de ambos mundos trabajando 3 días a la semana en nuestras espectaculares oficinas en pleno corazón de la Gran Vía de Granada y 2 días desde casa.
Teletrabajo 100%: Durante los periodos de Navidad, Semana Santa y verano para que disfrutes de una mayor comodidad y flexibilidad.

Vacaciones y más descanso:

25 días de vacaciones por convenio.
Tu cumpleaños libre para celebrarlo como prefieras. 🎉
Long Weekends: ¡12 viernes al año libres!
Mes adicional por baja de maternidad o paternidad.

Desarrollo profesional continuo:

Programas de formación interna y externa adaptados a tus necesidades.
Idiomas, liderazgo y especialización avanzada en áreas clave del marketing digital, social media, analítica de datos, herramientas de reporting e Inteligencia Artificial.
Acceso ilimitado a libros y recursos de aprendizaje para potenciar tus habilidades técnicas y consultivas.

Todo lo que necesitas para trabajar al máximo nivel:

Equipamiento de oficina premium y herramientas de monitorización avanzadas idóneas para que gestiones y analices las comunidades de la forma más cómoda y eficiente.

Beneficios exclusivos para empleados :

Descuentos en marcas líderes del mercado.

Compromiso con el impacto social:

Planes de voluntariado: participa en proyectos solidarios del entorno.
Planes de inclusión: apoyamos proyectos para la integración de colectivos vulnerables y prioritarios, promoviendo de forma activa un entorno de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y cohesionado.

Un entorno dinámico y colaborativo:

Un equipo apasionado donde crecer, con planes de carrera estructurados y un ambiente de constante aprendizaje y excelencia.

Sobre SIDN

SIDN es una compañía especializada en marketing digital, tecnología e innovación, comprometida con ofrecer un servicio de consultoría digital y estratégico de la máxima calidad. Llevamos más de 24 años transformando e impulsando negocios e instituciones en el canal digital, trabajando de la mano de grandes marcas, corporaciones líderes y ambiciosos proyectos internacionales, generando soluciones innovadoras con impacto real y medible.

¿Por qué unirte a nosotros?

Presencia global: Oficinas consolidadas en Granada, Madrid, Barcelona, Colonia, Miami y Santiago de Chile, ofreciendo una infraestructura sólida de soporte para todos nuestros equipos e implants.
Proyectos de envergadura: Colaboramos con clientes internacionales en proyectos que abarcan más de 60 países y se gestionan en más de 10 idiomas.
Cultura basada en el talento: Formada por un equipo humano de más de 200 profesionales apasionados, en constante crecimiento continuo y orientados firmemente hacia el aprendizaje continuo, la excelencia y la colaboración.
Crecimiento continuo: Nuestro éxito no solo se mide en resultados para nuestros clientes, sino también en nuestro propio crecimiento: más del 50% anual en los últimos 5 años y un impresionante 70% en los últimos 12 meses.
Entre las 500 primeras Pymes de España en crecimiento 2025.

Cultura que inspira

Creemos en construir un entorno donde puedas desarrollarte profesionalmente con el soporte de una metodología sólida de agencia. Fomentamos la flexibilidad adaptada a cada tipo de proyecto y contamos con reconocimientos externos que avalan nuestro foco en el bienestar del equipo y el crecimiento ordenado del talento digital.

¿Cómo es el proceso de selección en SIDN?

En SIDN buscamos personas con talento y ganas de marcar la diferencia. Nuestro proceso está diseñado de forma personalizada para que nos conozcamos a fondo y confirmemos la idoneidad con el proyecto:

Revisión de candidaturas: Analizamos detenidamente tu trayectoria profesional, así como los requerimientos y el portfolio aportados.
Entrevistas personalizadas: Realizamos hasta 3 entrevistas enfocadas en conocer tus conocimientos técnicos, habilidades, competencias y aptitudes para el entorno presencial en cliente y encaje con nuestra filosofía y cultura corporativa.
Propuesta final: Si eres la persona seleccionada, te presentaremos la oferta formal con las condiciones y detalles operativos de tu incorporacion, el equipo de soporte de SIDN y las condiciones específicas.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Digital Marketing Executive – SEO Specialization
Company: Movate
Role: Digital Marketing Executive – SEO
Experience: 1–4 Years
Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid)
Employment Type: Full-Time

About Movate
About the Company Movate, formerly called CSS CORP, is a new age services company that harnesses the power of
digital technologies to reimagine customer engagements. We enable businesses to anticipate and face disruptions
effectively through our digital, technology and support services. We are a global customer experience and
technology consulting services provider and a digital transformation partner of choice for its clients, which includes
the world’s top innovators across industries, from mid-market players to large enterprises. We have a diverse team
of over 11,500 customer-centric thinkers, collaborators, and co creators across 20 global locations.

Role Summary
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive with strong core SEO skills to grow organic visibility, traffic and
qualified leads. While SEO will be the primary focus, the role also contributes across the wider digital marketing
mix, including content, social media, paid campaigns, email marketing and analytics.
Key Responsibilities
Search Engine Optimization (Primary – approx. 70%)
• Keyword & competitor research: Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis and search-intent
mapping to build and maintain the SEO roadmap.
• On-page SEO: Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal linking, images and schema
markup.
• Technical SEO: Run regular site audits and resolve issues relating to crawlability, indexation, site speed,
Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, redirects, canonicals, sitemaps and robots.txt.
• Off-page SEO: Plan and execute ethical link-building through guest posts, digital PR, outreach and
partnerships; monitor and manage the backlink profile.
• SEO content: Brief writers, optimize blogs and landing pages, and refresh existing content to improve
rankings.
• Local SEO: Manage Google Business Profile and local citations where relevant.
• Emerging search: Optimize content for featured snippets and AI-driven search experiences (AI Overviews,
answer engines).
• Reporting: Track rankings, organic traffic, conversions and visibility; prepare weekly and monthly
performance reports with insights and recommendations.
Other Digital Marketing (Supporting – approx. 30%)
• Support Google Ads and paid social (LinkedIn, Meta) campaigns, including setup, keyword/audience
selection and performance monitoring.
• Plan and schedule social media content and track engagement.
• Assist with email marketing campaigns, newsletters and basic marketing automation.
• Coordinate website updates and landing pages in the CMS (e.g. WordPress) and recommend CRO
improvements.
• Set up and maintain tracking with GA4 and Google Tag Manager; build dashboards in Looker Studio.
• Work with design, content, sales and web teams to align campaigns with business goals.
Quality & Documentation
• Follow search engine guidelines and use only ethical, white-hat SEO practices; avoid spammy or
manipulative tactics.
• Maintain keyword trackers, audit checklists, content calendars and SEO documentation.
• Stay updated on search engine algorithm changes and industry trends, and adapt strategy accordingly.
• Communicate priorities clearly, meet deadlines and proactively flag risks or opportunities.
Required Skills & Qualifications
• 1–3 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in a B2B, IT services or agency environment.
• Strong command of on-page, off-page and technical SEO fundamentals and current search engine
guidelines.
• Proficiency with SEO tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush/Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and Moz.
• Working knowledge of at least two additional digital marketing areas, such as paid media (Google Ads/paid
social), social media, content marketing, email marketing or CRO.
• Familiarity with WordPress or similar CMS; basic understanding of HTML/CSS.
• Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for tracking and reporting.
• Ability to analyze data, interpret trends and translate them into clear actions.
• Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
Preferred / Good to Have
• Google Analytics, Google Ads or HubSpot certifications.
• Experience with international or multi-location SEO.
• Exposure to AI tools for content, research and SEO workflows.
• Basic graphic/content tools knowledge (e.g. Canva).
Key Performance Indicators
• Growth in organic traffic, keyword rankings and organic leads/conversions.
• Improvement in technical site health and Core Web Vitals scores.
• Quality and quantity of backlinks acquired.
• Timely, accurate reporting and campaign execution.
Personal Attributes
• Analytical, detail-oriented and results-driven.
• Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Collaborative team player.
Application Requirements
Candidates should share an updated CV and, where possible, a brief example of an SEO project describing the
challenge, actions taken, tools used and results achieved. Please do not include confidential client or employer
information.

Who We Are

At Fonroche Lighting America, we are transforming the way outdoor spaces are illuminated with off-grid, solar-powered street lighting. As the industry leader in autonomous solar lighting, we provide municipalities, developers, and commercial facilities with a cost-effective, reliable, and sustainable alternative to traditional grid-connected lighting.

With our U.S. headquarters in Fort Worth, TX, and regional offices nationwide, we are rapidly expanding—offering a dynamic work environment where innovation meets impact.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced SEO Specialist to join our Marketing Team and lead the continued growth of our organic search presence. This role will focus on technical SEO, keyword strategy, content optimization, search intent, analytics, and organic performance.

Working alongside the Marketing Team, you will develop and execute SEO strategies that increase our visibility across traditional search engines while ensuring our website provides valuable, authoritative information to prospective customers. You will work across technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, competitor research, and performance analytics to improve rankings, qualified organic traffic, and conversions.

As search continues to evolve, you will also stay informed on emerging AI-powered search experiences and incorporate relevant best practices into our broader organic search strategy.

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Organic Growth

Develop and execute comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with company marketing and business goals.
Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, search-intent analysis, SERP analysis, and content-gap research.
Identify opportunities to increase organic visibility for high-value commercial, municipal, industry, and product-related searches.
Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and overall search performance.
Develop strategies to improve rankings, qualified traffic, engagement, and lead generation.
Research emerging search trends and adjust SEO strategies accordingly.

Technical SEO

Conduct regular technical SEO audits and identify opportunities for improvement.
Monitor and improve site architecture, crawlability, indexability, canonicalization, redirects, internal linking, and URL structure.
Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile usability, and overall website performance.
Identify and troubleshoot technical issues affecting organic visibility.
Implement and maintain structured data and Schema.org markup.
Work with development and website resources to prioritize and resolve technical SEO issues.
Support SEO requirements for website redesigns, migrations, new pages, and other website initiatives.

On-Page SEO & Content Optimization

Optimize existing website pages to improve rankings, relevance, and user experience.
Develop SEO recommendations for landing pages, product pages, case studies, FAQs, blog articles, project pages, and educational resources.
Create SEO-focused content briefs based on keyword research, customer questions, search intent, and competitive analysis.
Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal links, image attributes, URLs, and on-page content.
Develop and maintain topic clusters to strengthen topical authority.
Identify opportunities to improve existing content based on search performance and changing search intent.
Ensure content is optimized for both search engines and human readers.

Link Building & Authority

Identify opportunities to strengthen website authority through high-quality backlinks, industry mentions, partnerships, and digital PR.
Monitor backlink profiles and identify potentially harmful or low-quality links.
Research competitor backlink strategies and identify relevant opportunities.
Support strategies that increase the company's authority and visibility within relevant industries.

Analytics & Reporting

Establish and monitor SEO KPIs and performance benchmarks.
Track organic rankings, traffic, conversions, engagement, backlinks, and technical SEO health.
Use Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and other SEO tools to analyze performance.
Identify trends and opportunities within organic search data.
Prepare regular SEO performance reports and communicate actionable insights to the Marketing Director and other stakeholders.
Connect organic search performance to qualified leads and broader marketing objectives.

AI & Emerging Search

Stay current with developments in AI-powered search and evolving search engine features.
Monitor how AI-generated search experiences may affect organic search behavior and website visibility.
Identify opportunities to structure and optimize content so it can be effectively understood and surfaced by emerging search technologies.
Incorporate relevant AI search, semantic search, and entity optimization practices into the overall SEO strategy as the industry evolves.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in B2B, technology, infrastructure, manufacturing, construction, SaaS, or other complex sales environments.
Strong understanding of technical SEO, on-page SEO, keyword research, search intent, and content optimization.
Demonstrated experience developing and implementing SEO strategies.
Experience conducting technical SEO audits and identifying website optimization opportunities.
Experience with Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush, and SEO tools such as Ahrefs and Screaming Frog.
Working knowledge of structured data and Schema.org.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn data into actionable recommendations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple SEO initiatives and prioritize opportunities based on business impact.
Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn and adapt as search engines and SEO best practices evolve.

Preferred Qualifications

WordPress experience; Avada experience is a plus.
Experience with enterprise or B2B SEO.
Experience with local and geographic SEO.
Experience with technical SEO for large or complex websites.
Experience with content strategy and topic-cluster development.
Experience with link-building, digital PR, and authority-building strategies.
Knowledge of entity SEO and semantic search.
Familiarity with AI-powered search platforms and emerging search technologies.
Experience in municipal, government, infrastructure, engineering, construction, energy, sustainability, or architectural markets is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first year, the successful candidate will help our company:

Increase qualified organic visibility and rankings for high-value commercial and municipal searches.
Increase qualified organic traffic and conversions.
Improve the technical health, crawlability, and overall SEO performance of the website.
Build stronger topical authority around customer needs, applications, technologies, products, and markets.
Identify and capitalize on new keyword and content opportunities.
Develop a consistent, data-driven SEO reporting and optimization process.
Improve the company's authority and visibility within relevant search results.
Establish a scalable SEO strategy that supports continued organic growth.

The Candidate We’re Looking For

We're looking for an SEO professional who is equally comfortable digging into technical website issues, analyzing search data, researching competitors, and identifying content opportunities.

You should be able to look at a website and determine not only what is preventing it from ranking, but also what opportunities exist to improve its visibility and attract the right customers. We're looking for someone who is analytical, curious, proactive, and excited about building a strong organic search presence for a growing company.

About the Role
We’re looking for a sharp SEO specialist who learns fast, works smart with AI, and takes ownership of results.
We care more about how quickly you pick things up than how long you’ve been doing this. If you’ve spent a year in SEO and already work faster and better than people with three, we want to hear from you.
At Digiholic, SEO covers the full picture of search: Google rankings, AI Overviews, and how brands show up in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini. You’ll work across B2B and B2C clients in India, the US and other markets, with direct mentoring from founders who have built SEO results for over two decades.

What You’ll Own
SEO performance for your client accounts: rankings, traffic, AI visibility and leads, with KPIs that are yours to hit
Keyword and intent research that focuses on what drives business, not just volume
On-page and technical SEO: audits, fixes, schema, internal linking, and working with our developer on anything beyond your reach
Content direction with the writing team: briefs, topic clusters and refresh plans
Monthly reports that explain what moved, why, and what you’re doing next
Using AI tools to work faster, and checking their output so speed never costs accuracy
Blog uploads and basic website upkeep

What We’re Looking For
1 to 3 years in SEO, or less if your work speaks for itself
Results you can point to, with a clear account of what you personally did
Comfort with GSC, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, and a crawler like Screaming Frog
Real, daily use of AI tools in your SEO workflow, not just for writing
Clear communication: you speak up, ask questions, and flag problems early
The confidence to own a number and explain it when it goes up or down

Have built your own prompts, workflows or automations for SEO tasks

Who This Role Isn’t For
If you prefer waiting for instructions, this won’t be the right fit. We’re looking for someone who comes to us with what they found, what they think, and what they’ve already tried.

You’ll own real accounts across industries and countries, learn directly from founders, and grow as fast as your results allow.

Describe one SEO task you’ve made significantly faster using AI. Which tools did you use, and how did you check the output was correct?
Share one result you owned, with numbers.

Nuestra manera de trabajar está basada en construir relaciones sólidas, proyectos bien planteados y experiencias que generan impacto real.

Estamos creciendo y queremos incorporar a nuestro equipo en Zaragoza a una persona con talento para transformar los datos en crecimiento. Buscamos un especialista en SEO & GEO (Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization) con pasión por proyectos de ecommerce y con experiencia en estrategias de crecimiento para unirse a nuestro equipo en Zaragoza.

Si te consideras una persona proactiva e inquieta por el crecimiento de negocios digitales, y te apasiona estar al día de las actualizaciones de los algoritmos de Google, la evolución de las búsquedas por IA y las novedades del sector ecommerce, ¡en Numéricco queremos conocerte!

Trabajarás para grandes marcas y negocios online de diferentes mercados, gestionando su estrategia de posicionamiento orgánico y visibilidad en motores generativos junto a un equipo motivado por hacer crecer los proyectos cuidando cada detalle.

Trabajarás junto a los equipos para entender sus retos y darles respuesta mediante dashboards y soluciones visuales que faciliten la toma de decisiones. Profundizarás en los datos para encontrar áreas de mejora operativa y nuevas vías para potenciar el crecimiento de los proyectos. Pasión y experimentación demostrable con herramientas de IA generativa y una comprensión clara de cómo está evolucionando el comportamiento del usuario hacia las búsquedas conversacionales y de long-tail.

Orientación a negocio y consultoría: Soltura en la presentación de resultados, empatía con el cliente y visión comercial para detectar nuevas oportunidades en la cuenta.

Experiencia en auditoría mediante prompts y monitorización de la visibilidad de marca frente a competidores en entornos conversacionales (OpenAI ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot...).

Capacidad de análisis cualitativo y cuantitativo para justificar el ROI del canal orgánico en los proyectos.
Capacidad de trabajo en equipo, proactividad y orientación a resultados.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita y verbal con clientes.
Organización, responsabilidad y cuidado por los detalles.

Conocimientos en automatización de tareas y Programmatic SEO(uso de Python, R o scripts para procesamiento de datos masivos o conexión con APIs).
Experiencia identificando y solventando problemas de indexación y renderizado en webs desarrolladas con frameworks de JavaScript(React, Next.js, Angular, etc.).

items.description:
Reelotek is a dynamic and fast-growing non-ferrous metals trading company with operations in Delhi NCR and Haryana. We specialize in trading high-quality zinc ingots, aluminum ingots, and aluminum wirerods, catering to diverse industries. With a commitment to reliable supply solutions and competitive pricing, we pride ourselves on building long-term relationships with our clients.

Vacancy: SEO Executive
Location: Delhi NCR
Experience: 1.5–3 years of hands-on SEO experience; proven ability to independently manage a website’s SEO
Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, IT or a related field; relevant practical experience is essential. Certifications in SEO, Google Analytics (GA4) or Google Search Console are an advantage.

Job Summary
Reelotek is looking for a proactive, detail-oriented SEO Executive to independently own and execute the company’s complete organic search strategy. The candidate must be hands-on across on-page, off-page and technical SEO, with working knowledge of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). This role includes keyword research, blog research and writing, quality backlink building, website audits, analytics, implementation and regular performance reporting.

Key Responsibilities

On-Page SEO, Keyword Research & Content:
• Own end-to-end SEO planning and execution for the Reelotek Metals website.
• Conduct industry, competitor and search-intent research; build keyword maps for product, category and blog pages.
• Optimize titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links, images, schema markup and landing-page content.
• Implement on-page SEO directly on WordPress websites, including page titles, meta descriptions, H1–H6 headings, URL slugs, image alt text, internal linking, content updates and SEO plugin settings (e.g., Yoast SEO or Rank Math).
• Research topics, create a blog calendar, and independently write, edit, publish or coordinate SEO-focused website blogs and articles.

Off-Page SEO & Backlink Building:
• Plan and execute ethical, relevant backlink outreach, guest posting, business listings and industry-specific link acquisition.
• Audit backlink quality, monitor referring domains and identify potentially harmful links; prioritize quality over volume.

Technical SEO:
• Run regular crawls and audits using Screaming Frog and other SEO tools; resolve indexing, crawlability, redirects, canonicals, duplicate content, broken links and XML sitemap issues.
• Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile usability, robots.txt, structured data and website architecture; implement fixes independently where access and skills permit.
• Use Google Search Console to identify and troubleshoot search-performance and indexing problems.

AEO, GEO & Search Updates:
• Optimize content for featured snippets, People Also Ask, conversational queries and answer-first search experiences.
• Apply GEO best practices to improve content clarity, authority, entity relevance and eligibility for AI-powered search discovery, without promising placement.
• Stay current with Google Search updates, algorithm changes and evolving AI search practices; adapt strategies proactively.

SEO Tools, Tracking & Reporting:
• Work confidently with SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Ubersuggest, Google Search Console and keyword / competitor research tools.
• Set up, use and troubleshoot GA4 and Google Tag Manager (GTM), including relevant events, conversions and tracking checks.
• Track organic traffic, keyword visibility, rankings, qualified enquiries, conversions, backlinks and technical health; provide monthly reports and action plans.

Key Skills & Competencies
• Strong working knowledge of on-page, off-page and technical SEO, AEO and GEO.
• Practical ability to research and write clear, original, search-optimized B2B / industrial website content.
• Hands-on expertise in SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Ubersuggest, Google Search Console, GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
• Understanding of HTML, basic CSS, CMS publishing (e.g., WordPress), schema markup and technical troubleshooting.
• Self-driven execution, high attention to detail, ownership and awareness of Google search updates.

What We Offer
• Opportunity to independently own the organic growth of a growing industrial business.
• Professional, collaborative work environment with direct impact on digital visibility and inbound enquiries.
